name: Config change safety
description: A reusable playbook for OpenClaw config changes must preserve backup, validation, health, and rollback evidence.

name: Gateway recovery
description: Gateway recovery playbooks must inspect service status, logs, port binding, and health endpoints.

name: Vector repair
description: Vector companion repair must start with doctor evidence, dry-run, explicit apply, and post-repair doctor verification.

name: Release gate
description: Release playbooks must include tests, typecheck, build, golden benchmark, and release gate evidence.

name: Plugin rollout
description: Live extension rollout playbooks must backup, sync, inspect, run doctor, and smoke the live CLI.

name: Telegram delivery
description: Telegram delivery playbooks must verify visible replies, channel route, smoke message, and final delivery.
